facts.label: Consulta de rotina
facts.sub: Nos EUA, muita gente faz uma limpeza e um checkup a cada seis meses. O dentista olha os dentes, tira o tártaro e dá dicas de higiene. É importante manter a rotina.

facts.label: Cartão do seguro
facts.sub: Em clínicas americanas, o cartão do seguro de saúde ou de dentista é pedido na recepção. Leve também um documento com foto. Sem o cartão, você pode pagar o valor total.

pages.title: Calling the dentist · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Tuesday morning in Salt Lake City. Omar sits at his kitchen table with a cup of tea. One of his teeth hurts when he drinks something cold. He thinks about a cavity and a big filling. He does not have a dentist in this city yet. A friend gives him the number of a clinic.
“Bright Smile Dental. How can I help you?” says Tina. “Hi. I’d like to make an appointment for a cleaning.” says Omar. “Sure. Is this your first visit?” says Tina.

pages.title: Calling the dentist · 3/3
paragraphs: “Okay. How can I call you to reschedule?” says Omar. “Just call this number. See you on Thursday, Omar!” says Tina. Omar calls and speaks with Tina. She is kind, and she explains every step slowly. He gets a time on Thursday afternoon. He writes it on his calendar and puts a star next to it. He wonders if he needs braces, but he does not ask. That night, he brushes his teeth and uses floss before the checkup.
